senior_debt.summary_method: Opening senior debt amount from backend operating-period debt schedule evidence. The displayed amount is anchored to the first operating-period senior balance and principal repayment fields.

capex.summary_method: CAPEX Total is sourced from the authoritative CAPEX structure used by the backend run. When upstream user sub-line materialization or scenario overrides are present, this displayed total reflects that authoritative structure.
capex.hierarchy_source: CapexStructure named fields surfaced through capex.capex_items().

revenue.summary_method: Total revenue from backend operating periods.

ebitda.summary_method: Total EBITDA from backend operating periods.

opex.summary_method: Total OPEX from backend operating periods.

dscr.summary_method: Average of operating-period DSCR values with positive senior debt service.

cfads.summary_method: Total CFADS across operating periods with positive senior debt service.

sizing.dscr_debt_capacity_standalone_basis: PROJECT_FINANCING_RESULT DSCR-only capacity pass (as in financing_evidence.bankability)
sizing.gearing_debt_capacity_basis: SOLVER_DIAGNOSTICS (eligible project cost x maximum gearing)
